description: Search clinical trials market-wide (cross-company). Distinct from get_clinical_trials, which is scoped to a single ticker. Filter by phase, indication, sponsor, status, and date window; sort and paginate the results. An unrecognised phase, status, dateField or sort value is rejected with the allowed list (it is never silently ignored). IMPORTANT: a result's ticker is the company whose trial list the row was collected under, which may be the lead sponsor OR only a collaborator; metadata.sponsor is the lead sponsor. Do not present a result as that ticker's own trial unless metadata.sponsor is that company; use get_clinical_trials for a company's role.

dateField.description: Date column the from/to window applies to (default primary_completion_date)

from.description: Inclusive start: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD

indication.description: Comma-separated condition names, exact match (case-sensitive), e.g. "Breast Cancer"

phase.description: Comma-separated phases, matching ANY of them. Allowed tokens: EARLY_PHASE1, PHASE1, PHASE2, PHASE3, PHASE4 (also accepted: "Phase 2", "2", "Early Phase 1"). Example: "PHASE2,PHASE3". A combined "Phase 2/Phase 3" string is rejected; list the phases instead.

sponsor.description: Case-insensitive substring of the LEAD sponsor name (collaborators are not searched)

to.description: Inclusive end: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (a partial date covers its whole year/month)

name: search_clinical_trials
title: Search Clinical Trials
